summary.text: Matt Shaheen is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 66 who has represented the district since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Matt Shaheen holds a bachelor's degree from Randolph-Macon College and a graduate degree from Southern Methodist University, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Human Services and Licensing & Administrative Procedures.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
